subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is '**fundamental**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explains the importance of work in human life.
 
• Blank (5) refers to the central or most important idea of existence.
 
• "**Fundamental**" means basic or essential, which perfectly fits the context.
 
• Other options such as "**uproar**", "**secondary**", and "**demean**" do not fit the sense of 'central idea of existence'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uproar **(कोलाहल): loud noise or commotion, not fitting the context of an 'idea of existence'.
 
• **Secondary **(द्वितीयक): means less important, opposite to the context of 'main idea'.
 
• **Demean** (अपमानित करना): means to lower in dignity, irrelevant to the passage.
